content.equation:
BSA = sqrt [(height * weight) / 3600]
BSA is calculated in m2
sqrt = square root
Height input in cm
Weight input in kg
CrCl = (k * height) / SCr
CrCl is calculated in mL/minute/1.73 m2
Height input in cm
SCr = Serum creatinine input in mg/dL
k is as follows:
Patients <1 year AND Birth weight = Low birth weight for gestational age
k = 0.33
Patients <1 year AND Birth weight = Appropriate birth weight for gestational age
k = 0.45
All Patients ≥1 year to <2 years
k = 0.45
Females ≥2 years to ≤16 years
k = 0.55
Males ≥2 to <13 years
k = 0.55
Males ≥13 to ≤16 years
k = 0.7
Note: If the calculated ClCr is >150 mL/minute/1.73 m2, then a maximum value of 150
mL/minute/1.73 m2 is used to calculate the dose.
Dose (mg) = 7 * BSA * CrCl
Dose (mg) is calculated in mg
Note: Calculated dose must be ≥5 mg for an output to be generated.
Note: When Oral solution (50 mg/mL) is selected as the dosage form AND the calculated dose
is ≥5 mg and <20 mg, the answer is rounded to the nearest 5 mg increment.

Note: When Tablet is selected as the dosage form, a recommended dose is only generated if
the calculated dose is within 10% of the available tablet dosage strength. The calculated dose

Dose (mL) = Dose (mg) / 50
Dose (mL) is calculated in mL
Dose (mg) is input in mg
Note: Dose (mL) is rounded to the nearest 0.1 mL when the calculated dose is <20 mg and 0.2
mL when the calculated dose is ≥20 mg.
notes: When the oral solution is chosen as the dosage form, the dose in mg is rounded to the nearest 5 mg (for calculated doses ≥5 mg and <20 mg) or 10 mg (for calculated doses ≥20 mg) increment. The preferred dosage form for pediatric patients is the oral solution; however, valganciclovir tablets may used so long as the calculated dose is within 10% of the available tablet strength (450 mg).
content.data_input_disclaimer: ONLY DIGITS 0 TO 9 AND A SINGLE DECIMAL POINT "." ARE ACCEPTABLE AS NUMERIC INPUTS. ATTEMPTED INPUT OF OTHER CHARACTERS INTO A NUMERIC FIELD MAY LEAD TO AN INCORRECT RESULT.
content.instructions: To perform a calculation, enter the required variables. Once all the inputs are entered, click the "Calculate" button to perform the calculation. Any time an input variable is adjusted, the "Calculate" button must be clicked to populate the new output. To start over, click the "Reset" button to clear all values and begin the calculation again. This calculation is intended to be used in pediatric patients ≤16 years; for children >16 years, refer to adult dosing.
